ko.title: 가상자산 규칙서의 시간 부족: 휴회 전 CLARITY 법안의 마지막 나날들

segments.src: *This article is a general explainer on pending U.S.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 공개된 의회 기록과 주요 뉴스 보도를 바탕으로 현재 계류 중인 미국

segments.src: legislation, based on publicly available congressional records and mainstream news reporting.
segments.tr: 입법안에 대한 일반적인 설명서입니다.

segments.src: Legislative schedules change quickly — verify the current status of any bill before relying on it.
segments.tr: 입법 일정은 빠르게 변경되므로, 법안에 의존하기 전에 현재 상태를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: Nothing here is investment, legal, or tax advice.*
segments.tr: 여기에 포함된 내용은 투자, 법률 또는 세무 자문이 아닙니다.*

segments.src: Washington runs on deadlines it sets for itself, and the one now pressing on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act is a simple line on a calendar: the Senate's August state work period, scheduled to begin around **August 10**.
segments.tr: 워싱턴은 스스로 설정한 마감 기한에 따라 움직이며, 현재 디지털 자산 시장 명확성 법(Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act)을 압박하고 있는 기한은 달력상의 단순한 선 하나, 즉 **8월 10일**경으로 예정된 상원의 8월 주정부 업무 기간입니다.

segments.src: Nothing legally expires that day.
segments.tr: 그날 법적으로 만료되는 것은 없습니다.

segments.src: No provision sunsets, no bill dies.
segments.tr: 일몰 조항이 발동되거나 법안이 폐기되는 것도 아닙니다.

segments.src: But a chamber that leaves town without moving a bill has, in practical terms, told you something about that bill's priority — and about the arithmetic waiting for it in the fall.
segments.tr: 하지만 법안을 처리하지 못한 채 도시를 떠나는 의회는 실질적으로 해당 법안의 우선순위, 그리고 가을에 기다리고 있을 산술적 상황에 대해 무언가를 말해주는 셈입니다.

segments.src: For what would be America's first comprehensive crypto **market-structure** law, the days before recess have become the whole story.
segments.tr: 미국 최초의 포괄적인 가상자산 **시장 구조(market-structure)** 법이 될 이 법안에 있어, 휴회 전의 며칠이 전체 이야기의 핵심이 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What the CLARITY Act is actually trying to do
segments.tr: ## CLARITY 법안이 실제로 하려는 것

segments.src: Start with the problem it addresses, because "crypto regulation" is a phrase that hides more than it explains.
segments.tr: "가상자산 규제"라는 문구는 설명하는 것보다 숨기는 것이 더 많기 때문에, 이 법안이 다루는 문제부터 시작하겠습니다.

segments.src: The United States already regulates digital assets.
segments.tr: 미국은 이미 디지털 자산을 규제하고 있습니다.

segments.src: It just does so through a patchwork of enforcement actions, decades-old case law, and two agencies with overlapping claims.
segments.tr: 다만 집행 조치의 짜깁기, 수십 년 된 판례, 그리고 권한이 겹치는 두 기관을 통해 그렇게 하고 있을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: The core question — is a given token a **security** (Securities and Exchange Commission turf) or a **commodity** (Commodity Futures Trading Commission turf)?
segments.tr: 핵심 질문인 '특정 토큰이 **증권**(증권거래위원회(SEC) 관할)인가, 아니면 **상품**(상품선물거래위원회(CFTC) 관할)인가?'라는 문제는

segments.src: — has largely been answered one lawsuit at a time.
segments.tr: 지금까지 주로 소송을 통해 하나씩 해결되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: The CLARITY Act, which passed the House in July 2025 with a substantial bipartisan majority, tries to answer it in statute instead.
segments.tr: 2025년 7월 상당한 초당적 다수로 하원을 통과한 CLARITY 법안은 이를 법전으로 해결하려 합니다.

segments.src: Broadly, it would:
segments.tr: 광범위하게 보면, 이 법안은 다음과 같은 내용을 담고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Split jurisdiction by asset type**, routing spot markets in "digital commodities" to the CFTC while leaving investment-contract offerings with the SEC.
segments.tr: - **자산 유형별로 관할권을 분리**하여, "디지털 상품"의 현물 시장은 CFTC로 보내고 투자 계약 제공은 SEC에 남겨둡니다.

segments.src: - **Create a registration path** for digital asset exchanges, brokers, and dealers, including provisional registration while rules are written.
segments.tr: - 디지털 자산 거래소, 브로커 및 딜러를 위한 **등록 경로를 생성**하며, 여기에는 규칙이 제정되는 동안의 임시 등록이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: - **Define a transition test** — often discussed as whether a blockchain has become sufficiently decentralized — that lets an asset move from the securities regime into the commodities regime as its underlying network matures.
segments.tr: - 블록체인이 충분히 탈중앙화되었는지 여부로 자주 논의되는 **전환 테스트(transition test)를 정의**하여, 기초 네트워크가 성숙함에 따라 자산이 증권 체제에서 상품 체제로 이동할 수 있도록 합니다.

segments.src: - **Set custody, disclosure, and customer-asset-segregation requirements** for intermediaries.
segments.tr: - 중개기관에 대한 **수탁, 공시 및 고객 자산 분리 요건을 설정**합니다.

segments.src: It is the second half of a two-part project.
segments.tr: 이것은 2부작 프로젝트의 후반부입니다.

segments.src: The first half, the stablecoin law enacted in 2025, was the easier lift: narrower subject, clearer analogies to existing payments regulation.
segments.tr: 전반부인 2025년에 제정된 스테이블코인 법은 주제가 더 좁고 기존 결제 규제와의 유사성이 명확하여 상대적으로 쉬운 과제였습니다.

segments.src: Market structure is where the genuinely hard trade-offs live.
segments.tr: 시장 구조야말로 진정으로 어려운 트레이드오프가 존재하는 영역입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the recess date matters more than it looks
segments.tr: ## 휴회 날짜가 생각보다 중요한 이유

segments.src: Floor time in the Senate is the scarcest resource in American government, and a bill like this consumes a lot of it.
segments.tr: 상원의 본회의 시간은 미국 정부에서 가장 희소한 자원이며, 이런 법안은 그 시간을 많이 소모합니다.

segments.src: Under normal order, market-structure legislation needs to clear **two committees** — Banking (for the securities side) and Agriculture (which oversees the CFTC) — before it gets a floor slot.
segments.tr: 정상적인 절차에 따르면, 시장 구조 입법안은 본회의 상정 전에 **두 개의 위원회** — 은행 위원회(증권 측면)와 농업 위원회(CFTC 감독) — 를 통과해야 합니다.

segments.src: It then needs 60 votes to break a filibuster, which means a meaningful bloc of Democratic support, not just party-line agreement.
segments.tr: 그 후 필리버스터를 저지하기 위해 60표가 필요한데, 이는 단순한 정당 간 합의가 아니라 민주당의 실질적인 지지 블록이 필요함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Each of those steps takes days the Senate does not have many of.
segments.tr: 이 단계들 각각은 상원이 많이 가지고 있지 않은 며칠의 시간을 소모합니다.

segments.src: The competing demands are familiar.
segments.tr: 경쟁하는 요구사항들은 익숙한 것들입니다.

segments.src: Appropriations deadlines arrive in the fall with a hard edge that crypto policy does not have.
segments.tr: 가을에 다가오는 예산 편성 마감일은 가상자산 정책이 가지지 못한 강력한 강제성을 띱니다.

segments.src: Nominations consume floor time continuously.
segments.tr: 인사 지명 건들이 지속적으로 본회의 시간을 소모합니다.

segments.src: And in an election year, the window for anything requiring sustained cross-party negotiation narrows sharply after Labor Day, as members redirect attention toward campaigns and toward votes that are easier to explain at home.
segments.tr: 그리고 선거철에는 의원들이 캠페인과 지역구에서 설명하기 쉬운 투표로 관심을 돌리면서, 지속적인 초당적 협상이 필요한 모든 일의 창구가 노동절 이후 급격히 좁아집니다.

segments.src: That's the real mechanism behind the "past 2026" warning.
segments.tr: 이것이 "2026년 이후"라는 경고 뒤에 숨겨진 실제 메커니즘입니다.

segments.src: If the bill doesn't have a negotiated text before recess, it returns in September into a shorter, more crowded calendar with less appetite for compromise.
segments.tr: 만약 휴회 전까지 협상된 텍스트가 나오지 않는다면, 이 법안은 9월에 더 짧고 더 붐비며 타협에 대한 의지가 더 적은 일정 속으로 돌아오게 됩니다.

segments.src: And bills that don't pass in a Congress don't carry over — they start again from introduction in the next one, with a possibly different committee balance and a re-litigated text.
segments.tr: 그리고 한 회기 내에 통과되지 못한 법안은 이월되지 않습니다. 다음 회기에서 다시 발의되어야 하며, 위원회 구성이 달라졌을 수 있고 텍스트에 대해 다시 논쟁해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Fight one: ethics rules for officeholders who hold tokens
segments.tr: ## 쟁점 1: 토큰 보유 공직자를 위한 윤리 규정

segments.src: The first unresolved issue is not about market plumbing at all.
segments.tr: 첫 번째 미결 이슈는 시장의 구조적 문제와는 전혀 상관이 없습니다.

segments.src: It's about who in government may own, issue, or promote digital assets.
segments.tr: 정부 내 누가 디지털 자산을 소유, 발행 또는 홍보할 수 있는가에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: Several Democratic negotiators have pressed for conflict-of-interest provisions — variously drafted to cover the President, Vice President, members of Congress, senior executive branch officials, and in some versions their immediate families — restricting the issuance or sponsorship of digital assets while in office.
segments.tr: 몇몇 민주당 협상가들은 이해상충 방지 조항을 강력히 요구해 왔습니다. 이 조항들은 대통령, 부통령, 의원, 행정부 고위 관리, 그리고 일부 버전에서는 그들의 직계 가족까지 포함하여 재임 중 디지털 자산의 발행이나 후원을 제한하도록 다양하게 초안이 작성되었습니다.

segments.src: Public reporting through 2025 and 2026 has tied the intensity of this demand to the crypto ventures associated with the President's family, and supporters describe it as a straightforward extension of existing financial conflict rules to a new asset class.
segments.tr: 2025년과 2026년의 공개 보도는 이러한 요구의 강도가 대통령 가족과 관련된 가상자산 벤처 사업과 연결되어 있다고 보았으며, 지지자들은 이를 기존의 금융 이해상충 규칙을 새로운 자산 클래스로 단순하게 확장한 것이라고 설명합니다.

segments.src: Republican negotiators have generally argued the opposite: that ethics rules are a separate subject from market structure, that folding them in converts a technical bill into a political one, and that any such provisions belong in standalone legislation.
segments.tr: 공화당 협상가들은 일반적으로 반대 입장을 취해 왔습니다. 윤리 규정은 시장 구조와는 별개의 주제이며, 이를 포함시키는 것은 기술적인 법안을 정치적인 법안으로 변질시키는 것이며, 그러한 조항은 별도의 입법안에 포함되어야 한다는 주장입니다.

segments.src: Both positions are internally coherent, which is exactly why the fight is hard.
segments.tr: 두 입장 모두 내부적으로 일관성이 있으며, 이것이 바로 이 싸움이 어려운 이유입니다.

segments.src: It isn't a drafting disagreement that a good staff lawyer can resolve overnight.
segments.tr: 이것은 유능한 법무 보좌관이 하룻밤 사이에 해결할 수 있는 초안 작성상의 이견이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It's a disagreement about what the bill is for — and for some Democrats, the ethics language has become the price of the votes needed to reach 60.
segments.tr: 이것은 법안의 목적이 무엇인가에 대한 이견이며, 일부 민주당원들에게 윤리 관련 문구는 60표를 얻기 위해 지불해야 할 가격이 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## Fight two: illicit finance
segments.tr: ## 쟁점 2: 불법 금융

segments.src: The second issue is more technical and, in some ways, harder.
segments.tr: 두 번째 이슈는 더 기술적이며, 어떤 면에서는 더 어렵습니다.

segments.src: Everyone in the debate agrees that sanctions evasion, ransomware payments, and laundering through digital assets are real problems.
segments.tr: 논쟁하는 모든 이들은 제재 회피, 랜섬웨어 결제, 디지털 자산을 통한 자금 세탁이 실제 문제라는 점에 동의합니다.

segments.src: The disagreement is about where obligations should attach.
segments.tr: 이견은 의무가 어디에 귀속되어야 하는가에 있습니다.

segments.src: Traditional anti-money-laundering law is built around **intermediaries**: a bank, a broker, an exchange — an entity that knows its customers and can file reports.
segments.tr: 전통적인 자금세탁방지법은 **중개기관**(은행, 브로커, 거래소 등 고객을 알고 보고서를 제출할 수 있는 엔티티)을 중심으로 구축되었습니다.

segments.src: Decentralized finance complicates that model.
segments.tr: 탈중앙화 금융(DeFi)은 이 모델을 복잡하게 만듭니다.

segments.src: When software runs autonomously and no one holds customer funds, it is genuinely unclear who the regulated party is supposed to be.
segments.tr: 소프트웨어가 자율적으로 실행되고 아무도 고객 자금을 보유하지 않을 때, 규제 대상이 누가 되어야 하는지는 정말로 불분명합니다.

segments.src: Two camps have formed.
segments.tr: 두 진영이 형성되었습니다.

segments.src: One wants to extend Bank Secrecy Act–style obligations further into the digital asset stack, arguing that a regime with structural gaps invites use of those gaps.
segments.tr: 한쪽은 은행비밀법(Bank Secrecy Act) 스타일의 의무를 디지털 자산 스택의 더 깊은 곳까지 확장하기를 원하며, 구조적 틈새가 있는 체제는 그 틈새의 이용을 초래한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: The other wants explicit protection for developers of non-custodial software — the position that publishing code isn't operating a money transmitting business — warning that broad liability would push development offshore without meaningfully deterring sophisticated bad actors.
segments.tr: 다른 쪽은 비수탁형 소프트웨어 개발자에 대한 명시적인 보호 — 코드를 게시하는 것이 자금 전송 사업을 운영하는 것이 아니라는 입장 — 를 원하며, 광범위한 책임 부과는 정교한 악의적 행위자를 실질적으로 저지하지 못한 채 개발을 해외로 밀어낼 것이라고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Related questions ride along: how to treat mixing services, what to do about privacy-preserving technologies with both legitimate and illegitimate uses, and how much new authority Treasury should receive.
segments.tr: 관련 질문들도 함께 따라옵니다. 믹싱 서비스를 어떻게 처리할 것인지, 정당한 용도와 부당한 용도가 모두 있는 프라이버시 보호 기술을 어떻게 다룰 것인지, 그리고 재무부가 얼마나 많은 새로운 권한을 부여받아야 하는지 등입니다.

segments.src: None of these have obvious compromise landing zones, and unlike the ethics fight, they can't be resolved by simply deciding whether a section stays in or comes out.
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 명백한 타협 지점이 없으며, 윤리 규정 싸움과 달리 단순히 특정 섹션을 남길지 뺄지를 결정함으로써 해결될 수 있는 문제가 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## What passing — or not — would actually change
segments.tr: ## 통과 여부가 실제로 바꾸는 것

segments.src: It's worth being precise about the stakes, because both sides of the debate have incentives to overstate them.
segments.tr: 논쟁의 양측 모두 상황을 과장하려는 유인이 있으므로, 이해관계에 대해 정확히 짚어볼 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: **If it passes:** firms gain a registration path and a defined regulator, which mainly affects institutional participants deciding how much compliance risk a U.S.
segments.tr: **통과될 경우:** 기업들은 등록 경로와 정의된 규제 기관을 얻게 되며, 이는 주로 미국

segments.src: business carries.
segments.tr: 사업이 어느 정도의 컴플라이언스 리스크를 지게 될지 결정하는 기관 투자자들에게 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: It would not eliminate volatility, fraud, or loss.
segments.tr: 그렇다고 변동성, 사기 또는 손실이 사라지는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Implementation would still take years of agency rulemaking after enactment.
segments.tr: 시행까지는 법 제정 후에도 수년간의 기관 규칙 제정 기간이 걸릴 것입니다.

segments.src: **If it stalls:** the current regime continues — meaning agency policy, enforcement discretion, and litigation outcomes remain the operative rulebook, and can shift with each administration.
segments.tr: **교착 상태가 될 경우:** 현재 체제가 유지됩니다. 즉, 기관의 정책, 집행 재량 및 소송 결과가 작동하는 규칙서로 남게 되며, 이는 정권이 바뀔 때마다 변할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That instability is the specific thing the industry says it wants fixed, and the specific thing skeptics say is preferable to a framework they consider too permissive.
segments.tr: 이러한 불안정성이 업계가 해결되기를 원하는 구체적인 지점이며, 회의론자들이 너무 허용적이라고 생각하는 프레임워크보다 선호한다고 말하는 구체적인 지점이기도 합니다.

segments.src: Neither outcome is a verdict on any particular asset's value.
segments.tr: 어떤 결과도 특정 자산의 가치에 대한 판결이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Legislation shapes who supervises a market; it does not underwrite it.
segments.tr: 입법은 누가 시장을 감독하는지를 결정하는 것이지, 시장을 보증하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch in the next few days
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 며칠간 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: A handful of concrete signals will tell you more than any headline:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 구체적인 신호가 그 어떤 헤드라인보다 더 많은 것을 말해줄 것입니다:

segments.src: 1. **Does a joint Banking–Agriculture text appear?** A single released draft with both committees' names on it is the clearest evidence real negotiation succeeded.
segments.tr: 1. **은행-농업 위원회 공동 텍스트가 나타나는가?** 두 위원회의 이름이 모두 적힌 단일 초안이 공개된다면, 이는 실제 협상이 성공했다는 가장 명확한 증거입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Is a markup noticed?** Committees post hearing and markup notices in advance. No notice before recess means no committee action before September.
segments.tr: 2. **마크업(수정안 심의) 공고가 났는가?** 위원회는 청문회 및 마크업 공고를 사전에 게시합니다. 휴회 전까지 공고가 없다면 9월 전까지 위원회 조치는 없다는 뜻입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Do the Democratic negotiators issue a statement?** Whether the group that has been negotiating describes talks as ongoing or stalled is the most direct read on whether 60 votes are reachable.
segments.tr: 3. **민주당 협상가들이 성명을 발표하는가?** 협상을 진행해 온 그룹이 회담을 '진행 중'으로 묘사하는지 아니면 '교착 상태'로 묘사하는지가 60표 확보 가능 여부를 판단하는 가장 직접적인 척도입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Is the ethics language in a separate vehicle?** If conflict-of-interest provisions get spun into a standalone bill, that's the shape a compromise would most likely take.
segments.tr: 4. **윤리 관련 문구가 별도의 법안으로 분리되었는가?** 이해상충 방지 조항이 독립된 법안으로 분리된다면, 그것이 타협이 이루어질 가능성이 가장 높은 형태입니다.

segments.src: 5. **Does leadership commit floor time for the fall?** A scheduling commitment survives recess; a general expression of support usually doesn't.
segments.tr: 5. **지도부가 가을 본회의 시간을 약속하는가?** 일정에 대한 약속은 휴회 후에도 유지되지만, 일반적인 지지 표명은 대개 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## The unglamorous conclusion
segments.tr: ## 화려하지 않은 결론

segments.src: Big legislation rarely fails because someone loses an argument.
segments.tr: 거대 입법안이 누군가 논쟁에서 졌기 때문에 실패하는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: It fails because the calendar closes while the argument is still running.
segments.tr: 논쟁이 계속되는 동안 달력의 시간이 다 되었기 때문에 실패하는 것입니다.

segments.src: The CLARITY Act cleared the harder-looking chamber more than a year ago with bipartisan support.
segments.tr: CLARITY 법안은 1년여 전 초당적 지지를 받으며 더 어려워 보였던 하원을 통과했습니다.

segments.src: What it faces now isn't ideological opposition so much as arithmetic: two genuinely unresolved policy fights, two committees of jurisdiction, a 60-vote threshold, and a shrinking number of legislative days before an election year absorbs whatever is left.
segments.tr: 현재 직면한 문제는 이념적 반대라기보다 산술적인 문제입니다. 해결되지 않은 두 가지 정책 쟁점, 관할 위원회 두 곳, 60표의 문턱, 그리고 선거철이 남은 시간을 모두 흡수하기 전까지 줄어드는 입법 가능 일수입니다.

segments.src: That may still be enough.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 충분할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Congress has done more in less time when leadership decided a bill would move.
segments.tr: 지도부가 법안을 추진하기로 결정했을 때 의회는 더 짧은 시간 안에 더 많은 일을 해냈습니다.

segments.src: But the honest read, as the Senate approaches its August departure, is that the outcome depends less on the merits of the framework than on whether two negotiating teams can close two hard gaps in a very small number of working days — and, failing that, whether anyone still has the appetite to pick it up again in September.
segments.tr: 하지만 상원이 8월 휴회를 앞둔 시점에서 솔직한 진단은, 결과가 프레임워크의 장점보다는 두 협상 팀이 매우 적은 근무일 안에 두 가지 어려운 간극을 메울 수 있는지, 그리고 그것이 실패했을 때 9월에 다시 이를 추진할 의지가 남아 있을지에 달려 있다는 것입니다.

zh.title: 加密货币规则书的时间告急：CLARITY 法案在休会前的最后日子

segments.src: *This article is a general explainer on pending U.S.
segments.tr: *本文是对待决的美国

segments.src: legislation, based on publicly available congressional records and mainstream news reporting.
segments.tr: 立法的一般性解释，基于公开的国会记录和主流新闻报道。

segments.src: Legislative schedules change quickly — verify the current status of any bill before relying on it.
segments.tr: 立法时间表变化很快——在依赖任何法案之前，请核实其当前状态。

segments.src: Nothing here is investment, legal, or tax advice.*
segments.tr: 此处没有任何内容构成投资、法律或税务建议。*

segments.src: Washington runs on deadlines it sets for itself, and the one now pressing on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act is a simple line on a calendar: the Senate's August state work period, scheduled to begin around **August 10**.
segments.tr: 华盛顿运行在它为自己设定的截止日期上，而现在压在《数字资产市场清晰度法案》（Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act）上的压力，就是日历上的一个简单线条：参议院 8 月的州工作期，计划在 **8 月 10 日** 左右开始。

segments.src: Nothing legally expires that day.
segments.tr: 当天没有任何法律上的到期。

segments.src: No provision sunsets, no bill dies.
segments.tr: 没有条款失效，没有法案死亡。

segments.src: But a chamber that leaves town without moving a bill has, in practical terms, told you something about that bill's priority — and about the arithmetic waiting for it in the fall.
segments.tr: 但一个在没有推进法案的情况下离开城镇的议院，在实际操作中，已经告诉你了关于该法案的优先级——以及秋季等待它的算术题。

segments.src: For what would be America's first comprehensive crypto **market-structure** law, the days before recess have become the whole story.
segments.tr: 对于这将成为美国首部综合性加密货币 **市场结构** 法律的法案来说，休会前的日子已成为整个故事的核心。

segments.src: ## What the CLARITY Act is actually trying to do
segments.tr: ## CLARITY 法案实际上试图做什么

segments.src: Start with the problem it addresses, because "crypto regulation" is a phrase that hides more than it explains.
segments.tr: 首先从它要解决的问题开始，因为“加密货币监管”这个词隐藏的比解释的更多。

segments.src: The United States already regulates digital assets.
segments.tr: 美国已经监管数字资产。

segments.src: It just does so through a patchwork of enforcement actions, decades-old case law, and two agencies with overlapping claims.
segments.tr: 它只是通过一系列补丁式的执法行动、数十年前的判例法以及两个权力主张重叠的机构来实施的。

segments.src: The core question — is a given token a **security** (Securities and Exchange Commission turf) or a **commodity** (Commodity Futures Trading Commission turf)?
segments.tr: 核心问题——某个代币是 **证券**（证券交易委员会 SEC 的管辖范围）还是 **商品**（商品期货交易委员会 CFTC 的管辖范围）？

segments.src: — has largely been answered one lawsuit at a time.
segments.tr: ——在很大程度上是通过一个接一个的诉讼来回答的。

segments.src: The CLARITY Act, which passed the House in July 2025 with a substantial bipartisan majority, tries to answer it in statute instead.
segments.tr: CLARITY 法案在 2025 年 7 月以大幅跨党派多数通过了众议院，它试图通过成文法来回答这个问题。

segments.src: Broadly, it would:
segments.tr: 广义上，它将：

segments.src: - **Split jurisdiction by asset type**, routing spot markets in "digital commodities" to the CFTC while leaving investment-contract offerings with the SEC.
segments.tr: - **按资产类型划分管辖权**，将“数字商品”的现货市场路由至 CFTC，而将投资合同发行留给 SEC。

segments.src: - **Create a registration path** for digital asset exchanges, brokers, and dealers, including provisional registration while rules are written.
segments.tr: - **为数字资产交易所、经纪商和交易商创建注册路径**，包括在规则制定期间的临时注册。

segments.src: - **Define a transition test** — often discussed as whether a blockchain has become sufficiently decentralized — that lets an asset move from the securities regime into the commodities regime as its underlying network matures.
segments.tr: - **定义一个过渡测试**——通常讨论的是区块链是否已变得足够去中心化——允许资产随着其底层网络的成熟，从证券体系转移到商品体系。

segments.src: - **Set custody, disclosure, and customer-asset-segregation requirements** for intermediaries.
segments.tr: - **为中介机构设定托管、披露和客户资产隔离要求**。

segments.src: It is the second half of a two-part project.
segments.tr: 它是两部分项目中的后半部分。

segments.src: The first half, the stablecoin law enacted in 2025, was the easier lift: narrower subject, clearer analogies to existing payments regulation.
segments.tr: 前半部分是 2025 年颁布的稳定币法律，那部分更容易推进：主题更窄，与现有支付监管的类比更清晰。

segments.src: Market structure is where the genuinely hard trade-offs live.
segments.tr: 市场结构才是真正存在艰难权衡的地方。

segments.src: ## Why the recess date matters more than it looks
segments.tr: ## 为什么休会日期比看起来更重要

segments.src: Floor time in the Senate is the scarcest resource in American government, and a bill like this consumes a lot of it.
segments.tr: 参议院的议事时间是美国政府中最稀缺的资源，而像这样的法案会消耗大量时间。

segments.src: Under normal order, market-structure legislation needs to clear **two committees** — Banking (for the securities side) and Agriculture (which oversees the CFTC) — before it gets a floor slot.
segments.tr: 在正常程序下，市场结构立法需要通过 **两个委员会**——银行委员会（负责证券方面）和农业委员会（监督 CFTC）——才能获得议事席位。

segments.src: It then needs 60 votes to break a filibuster, which means a meaningful bloc of Democratic support, not just party-line agreement.
segments.tr: 然后它需要 60 票来打破冗长辩论（filibuster），这意味着需要民主党有实质性的支持，而不仅仅是党派内部的一致。

segments.src: Each of those steps takes days the Senate does not have many of.
segments.tr: 这些步骤中的每一步都需要参议院并不太多的时间。

segments.src: The competing demands are familiar.
segments.tr: 竞争的需求是熟悉的。

segments.src: Appropriations deadlines arrive in the fall with a hard edge that crypto policy does not have.
segments.tr: 拨款截止日期在秋季到来，具有加密货币政策所不具备的强制性。

segments.src: Nominations consume floor time continuously.
segments.tr: 提名人选持续消耗议事时间。

segments.src: And in an election year, the window for anything requiring sustained cross-party negotiation narrows sharply after Labor Day, as members redirect attention toward campaigns and toward votes that are easier to explain at home.
segments.tr: 而且在选举年，任何需要持续跨党派谈判的窗口在劳动节之后都会急剧缩小，因为议员们会将注意力转向竞选以及那些在家乡更容易解释的投票。

segments.src: That's the real mechanism behind the "past 2026" warning.
segments.tr: 这就是“超过 2026 年”警告背后的真实机制。

segments.src: If the bill doesn't have a negotiated text before recess, it returns in September into a shorter, more crowded calendar with less appetite for compromise.
segments.tr: 如果法案在休会前没有协商出文本，它将在 9 月回到一个更短、更拥挤的日程表中，且妥协意愿更低。

segments.src: And bills that don't pass in a Congress don't carry over — they start again from introduction in the next one, with a possibly different committee balance and a re-litigated text.
segments.tr: 而且在某一届国会中未能通过的法案不会结转——它们在下一届国会中必须从提交起重新开始，且可能面临不同的委员会平衡和重新争论的文本。

segments.src: ## Fight one: ethics rules for officeholders who hold tokens
segments.tr: ## 争端一：持有代币的公职人员的伦理规则

segments.src: The first unresolved issue is not about market plumbing at all.
segments.tr: 第一个未解决的问题根本不是关于市场机制的。

segments.src: It's about who in government may own, issue, or promote digital assets.
segments.tr: 而是关于政府中谁可以拥有、发行或推广数字资产。

segments.src: Several Democratic negotiators have pressed for conflict-of-interest provisions — variously drafted to cover the President, Vice President, members of Congress, senior executive branch officials, and in some versions their immediate families — restricting the issuance or sponsorship of digital assets while in office.
segments.tr: 几位民主党谈判代表敦促加入利益冲突条款——其起草版本各异，涵盖总统、副总统、国会议员、行政部门高级官员，在某些版本中还包括其直系亲属——限制在任期间发行或赞助数字资产。

segments.src: Public reporting through 2025 and 2026 has tied the intensity of this demand to the crypto ventures associated with the President's family, and supporters describe it as a straightforward extension of existing financial conflict rules to a new asset class.
segments.tr: 2025 年和 2026 年的公开报道将这一需求的强度与总统家族相关的加密货币风险投资联系在一起，支持者将其描述为将现有的金融冲突规则简单地扩展到新资产类别。

segments.src: Republican negotiators have generally argued the opposite: that ethics rules are a separate subject from market structure, that folding them in converts a technical bill into a political one, and that any such provisions belong in standalone legislation.
segments.tr: 共和党谈判代表通常持相反观点：伦理规则是与市场结构独立的主题，将其合并会将技术性法案变为政治性法案，且任何此类条款应在独立立法中处理。

segments.src: Both positions are internally coherent, which is exactly why the fight is hard.
segments.tr: 两种立场在内部逻辑上都是自洽的，这正是这场争斗如此艰难的原因。

segments.src: It isn't a drafting disagreement that a good staff lawyer can resolve overnight.
segments.tr: 这并不是一个优秀的法律助手可以通过一夜之间解决的起草分歧。

segments.src: It's a disagreement about what the bill is for — and for some Democrats, the ethics language has become the price of the votes needed to reach 60.
segments.tr: 这是一个关于法案目的的分歧——对于一些民主党人来说，伦理条款已成为获得 60 票所需支持的代价。

segments.src: ## Fight two: illicit finance
segments.tr: ## 争端二：非法金融

segments.src: The second issue is more technical and, in some ways, harder.
segments.tr: 第二个问题更具技术性，且在某些方面更难。

segments.src: Everyone in the debate agrees that sanctions evasion, ransomware payments, and laundering through digital assets are real problems.
segments.tr: 辩论中的每个人都同意，规避制裁、勒索软件支付以及通过数字资产洗钱是真实存在的问题。

segments.src: The disagreement is about where obligations should attach.
segments.tr: 分歧在于义务应由谁承担。

segments.src: Traditional anti-money-laundering law is built around **intermediaries**: a bank, a broker, an exchange — an entity that knows its customers and can file reports.
segments.tr: 传统的反洗钱法围绕 **中介机构** 构建：银行、经纪商、交易所——一个了解其客户并能提交报告的实体。

segments.src: Decentralized finance complicates that model.
segments.tr: 去中心化金融（DeFi）使该模型复杂化。

segments.src: When software runs autonomously and no one holds customer funds, it is genuinely unclear who the regulated party is supposed to be.
segments.tr: 当软件自主运行且没有人持有客户资金时，监管对象究竟应该是谁，确实不明确。

segments.src: Two camps have formed.
segments.tr: 目前形成了两个阵营。

segments.src: One wants to extend Bank Secrecy Act–style obligations further into the digital asset stack, arguing that a regime with structural gaps invites use of those gaps.
segments.tr: 一方希望将《银行保密法》（Bank Secrecy Act）风格的义务进一步扩展到数字资产技术栈中，认为一个具有结构性漏洞的体系会诱使人们利用这些漏洞。

segments.src: The other wants explicit protection for developers of non-custodial software — the position that publishing code isn't operating a money transmitting business — warning that broad liability would push development offshore without meaningfully deterring sophisticated bad actors.
segments.tr: 另一方则希望为非托管软件的开发者提供明确保护——主张发布代码不等于经营资金传输业务——并警告说，广泛的责任将把开发推向海外，而不能有效威慑复杂的恶意行为者。

segments.src: Related questions ride along: how to treat mixing services, what to do about privacy-preserving technologies with both legitimate and illegitimate uses, and how much new authority Treasury should receive.
segments.tr: 相关问题随之而来：如何对待混币服务、如何处理具有合法和非法用途的隐私保护技术，以及财政部应获得多少新权力。

segments.src: None of these have obvious compromise landing zones, and unlike the ethics fight, they can't be resolved by simply deciding whether a section stays in or comes out.
segments.tr: 这些问题都没有明显的妥协地带，而且与伦理之争不同，它们不能简单地通过决定某个章节是否保留来解决。

segments.src: ## What passing — or not — would actually change
segments.tr: ## 通过（或不通过）实际上会改变什么

segments.src: It's worth being precise about the stakes, because both sides of the debate have incentives to overstate them.
segments.tr: 精确定义赌注是值得的，因为辩论双方都有夸大赌注的动机。

segments.src: **If it passes:** firms gain a registration path and a defined regulator, which mainly affects institutional participants deciding how much compliance risk a U.S.
segments.tr: **如果通过：** 公司将获得注册路径和明确的监管机构，这主要影响决定美国业务承担多少合规风险的机构参与者。

segments.src: business carries.
segments.tr: 业务承担。

segments.src: It would not eliminate volatility, fraud, or loss.
segments.tr: 它不会消除波动性、欺诈或损失。

segments.src: Implementation would still take years of agency rulemaking after enactment.
segments.tr: 实施仍将在法案颁布后需要数年的机构规则制定过程。

segments.src: **If it stalls:** the current regime continues — meaning agency policy, enforcement discretion, and litigation outcomes remain the operative rulebook, and can shift with each administration.
segments.tr: **如果停滞：** 当前体制将继续——这意味着机构政策、执法自由裁量权和诉讼结果仍是实际的规则书，并且可能随每届政府而变化。

segments.src: That instability is the specific thing the industry says it wants fixed, and the specific thing skeptics say is preferable to a framework they consider too permissive.
segments.tr: 这种不稳定性正是行业希望修复的具体问题，也是怀疑论者认为比他们认为过于宽松的框架更可取的地方。

segments.src: Neither outcome is a verdict on any particular asset's value.
segments.tr: 无论哪种结果都不是对任何特定资产价值的判定。

segments.src: Legislation shapes who supervises a market; it does not underwrite it.
segments.tr: 立法塑造的是谁监督市场；它并不为市场背书。

segments.src: ## What to watch in the next few days
segments.tr: ## 未来几天需要关注什么

segments.src: A handful of concrete signals will tell you more than any headline:
segments.tr: 几个具体的信号将比任何头条新闻提供更多信息：

segments.src: 1. **Does a joint Banking–Agriculture text appear?** A single released draft with both committees' names on it is the clearest evidence real negotiation succeeded.
segments.tr: 1. **是否出现银行-农业委员会的联合文本？** 一份同时带有两个委员会名称的单一发布草案是真实谈判成功的最清晰证据。

segments.src: 2. **Is a markup noticed?** Committees post hearing and markup notices in advance. No notice before recess means no committee action before September.
segments.tr: 2. **是否发布了审议通知？** 委员会会提前发布听证会和审议通知。休会前没有通知意味着 9 月之前没有委员会行动。

segments.src: 3. **Do the Democratic negotiators issue a statement?** Whether the group that has been negotiating describes talks as ongoing or stalled is the most direct read on whether 60 votes are reachable.
segments.tr: 3. **民主党谈判代表是否发表声明？** 负责谈判的小组是否将谈话描述为进行中或停滞，是对 60 票是否可行的最直接判断。

segments.src: 4. **Is the ethics language in a separate vehicle?** If conflict-of-interest provisions get spun into a standalone bill, that's the shape a compromise would most likely take.
segments.tr: 4. **伦理条款是否在独立载体中？** 如果利益冲突条款被拆分为独立法案，这就是妥协最可能采取的形式。

segments.src: 5. **Does leadership commit floor time for the fall?** A scheduling commitment survives recess; a general expression of support usually doesn't.
segments.tr: 5. **领导层是否承诺秋季的议事时间？** 时间表承诺在休会后依然有效；而一般的支持表达通常不会。

segments.src: ## The unglamorous conclusion
segments.tr: ## 不太光彩的结论

segments.src: Big legislation rarely fails because someone loses an argument.
segments.tr: 重大立法很少因为有人输掉争论而失败。

segments.src: It fails because the calendar closes while the argument is still running.
segments.tr: 它失败是因为在争论仍在进行时，日历关闭了。

segments.src: The CLARITY Act cleared the harder-looking chamber more than a year ago with bipartisan support.
segments.tr: CLARITY 法案在一年多前以跨党派支持通过了看起来更难的议院。

segments.src: What it faces now isn't ideological opposition so much as arithmetic: two genuinely unresolved policy fights, two committees of jurisdiction, a 60-vote threshold, and a shrinking number of legislative days before an election year absorbs whatever is left.
segments.tr: 它现在面临的不是意识形态的反对，而是算术题：两个真正未解决的政策争端、两个管辖委员会、60 票的门槛，以及在选举年吞噬所有剩余时间之前不断缩短的立法天数。

segments.src: That may still be enough.
segments.tr: 但这可能仍然足够。

segments.src: Congress has done more in less time when leadership decided a bill would move.
segments.tr: 当领导层决定推进法案时，国会曾在更短时间内完成更多工作。

segments.src: But the honest read, as the Senate approaches its August departure, is that the outcome depends less on the merits of the framework than on whether two negotiating teams can close two hard gaps in a very small number of working days — and, failing that, whether anyone still has the appetite to pick it up again in September.
segments.tr: 但随着参议院接近 8 月的离职，诚实的解读是，结果与其说是取决于框架的优劣，不如说取决于两个谈判团队能否在极少数的工作日内填补两个艰难的缺口——如果失败，是否还有人有兴趣在 9 月再次启动它。

hi.title: एक क्रिप्टो रूलबुक का कैलेंडर समाप्त हो रहा है: अवकाश से पहले CLARITY एक्ट के अंतिम दिन

segments.src: *This article is a general explainer on pending U.S.
segments.tr: *यह लेख लंबित अमेरिकी

segments.src: legislation, based on publicly available congressional records and mainstream news reporting.
segments.tr: विधायन पर एक सामान्य व्याख्या है, जो सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध कांग्रेस रिकॉर्ड और मुख्यधारा की समाचार रिपोर्टिंग पर आधारित है।

segments.src: Legislative schedules change quickly — verify the current status of any bill before relying on it.
segments.tr: विधायी कार्यक्रम तेजी से बदलते हैं — किसी भी विधेयक पर भरोसा करने से पहले उसकी वर्तमान स्थिति की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: Nothing here is investment, legal, or tax advice.*
segments.tr: यहाँ कुछ भी निवेश, कानूनी या कर सलाह नहीं है।*

segments.src: Washington runs on deadlines it sets for itself, and the one now pressing on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act is a simple line on a calendar: the Senate's August state work period, scheduled to begin around **August 10**.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन उन समय-सीमाओं पर चलता है जो वह खुद के लिए निर्धारित करता है, और डिजिटल एसेट मार्केट CLARITY एक्ट पर अब जो दबाव है वह कैलेंडर पर एक साधारण रेखा है: सीनेट की अगस्त राज्य कार्य अवधि, जो लगभग **10 अगस्त** के आसपास शुरू होने वाली है।

segments.src: Nothing legally expires that day.
segments.tr: उस दिन कानूनी रूप से कुछ भी समाप्त नहीं होता है।

segments.src: No provision sunsets, no bill dies.
segments.tr: कोई प्रावधान समाप्त नहीं होता, कोई विधेयक नहीं मरता।

segments.src: But a chamber that leaves town without moving a bill has, in practical terms, told you something about that bill's priority — and about the arithmetic waiting for it in the fall.
segments.tr: लेकिन एक सदन जो विधेयक को आगे बढ़ाए बिना शहर छोड़ देता है, उसने व्यावहारिक रूप से आपको उस विधेयक की प्राथमिकता के बारे में — और पतझड़ में उसका इंतजार कर रहे गणित के बारे में कुछ बता दिया है।

segments.src: For what would be America's first comprehensive crypto **market-structure** law, the days before recess have become the whole story.
segments.tr: अमेरिका के पहले व्यापक क्रिप्टो **मार्केट-स्ट्रक्चर** (बाजार-संरचना) कानून के लिए, अवकाश से पहले के दिन पूरी कहानी बन गए हैं।

segments.src: ## What the CLARITY Act is actually trying to do
segments.tr: ## CLARITY एक्ट वास्तव में क्या करने की कोशिश कर रहा है

segments.src: Start with the problem it addresses, because "crypto regulation" is a phrase that hides more than it explains.
segments.tr: उस समस्या से शुरू करें जिसे यह संबोधित करता है, क्योंकि "क्रिप्टो रेगुलेशन" एक ऐसा वाक्यांश है जो समझाने से ज्यादा छुपाता है।

segments.src: The United States already regulates digital assets.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका पहले से ही डिजिटल संपत्तियों को विनियमित करता है।

segments.src: It just does so through a patchwork of enforcement actions, decades-old case law, and two agencies with overlapping claims.
segments.tr: यह बस प्रवर्तन कार्रवाइयों, दशकों पुराने केस कानून और ओवरलैपिंग दावों वाली दो एजेंसियों के एक पैचवर्क के माध्यम से ऐसा करता है।

segments.src: The core question — is a given token a **security** (Securities and Exchange Commission turf) or a **commodity** (Commodity Futures Trading Commission turf)?
segments.tr: मुख्य प्रश्न — क्या कोई दिया गया टोकन एक **सिक्योरिटी** (Securities and Exchange Commission का क्षेत्र) है या एक **कमोडिटी** (Commodity Futures Trading Commission का क्षेत्र)?

segments.src: — has largely been answered one lawsuit at a time.
segments.tr: — इसका उत्तर काफी हद तक एक समय में एक मुकदमे के माध्यम से दिया गया है।

segments.src: The CLARITY Act, which passed the House in July 2025 with a substantial bipartisan majority, tries to answer it in statute instead.
segments.tr: CLARITY एक्ट, जो जुलाई 2025 में एक पर्याप्त द्विदलीय बहुमत के साथ हाउस से पारित हुआ, इसके बजाय इसे कानून में उत्तर देने की कोशिश करता है।

segments.src: Broadly, it would:
segments.tr: व्यापक रूप से, यह करेगा:

segments.src: - **Split jurisdiction by asset type**, routing spot markets in "digital commodities" to the CFTC while leaving investment-contract offerings with the SEC.
segments.tr: - **संपत्ति के प्रकार द्वारा अधिकार क्षेत्र को विभाजित करना**, "डिजिटल कमोडिटीज" में स्पॉट मार्केट्स को CFTC की ओर भेजना जबकि इन्वेस्टमेंट-कॉन्ट्रैक्ट ऑफरिंग्स को SEC के पास छोड़ना।

segments.src: - **Create a registration path** for digital asset exchanges, brokers, and dealers, including provisional registration while rules are written.
segments.tr: - डिजिटल संपत्ति एक्सचेंजों, ब्रोकरों और डीलरों के लिए एक **पंजीकरण पथ बनाना**, जिसमें नियम लिखे जाने के दौरान अनंतिम पंजीकरण शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Define a transition test** — often discussed as whether a blockchain has become sufficiently decentralized — that lets an asset move from the securities regime into the commodities regime as its underlying network matures.
segments.tr: - एक **ट्रांज़िशन टेस्ट (संक्रमण परीक्षण) को परिभाषित करना** — जिस पर अक्सर चर्चा की जाती है कि क्या एक ब्लॉकचेन पर्याप्त रूप से विकेंद्रीकृत हो गया है — जो एक संपत्ति को उसके अंतर्निहित नेटवर्क के परिपक्व होने पर सिक्योरिटीज शासन से कमोडिटीज शासन में जाने देता है।

segments.src: - **Set custody, disclosure, and customer-asset-segregation requirements** for intermediaries.
segments.tr: - मध्यस्थों के लिए **कस्टडी, प्रकटीकरण और ग्राहक-संपत्ति-पृथक्करण आवश्यकताओं को निर्धारित करना**।

segments.src: It is the second half of a two-part project.
segments.tr: यह दो भागों वाली परियोजना का दूसरा हिस्सा है।

segments.src: The first half, the stablecoin law enacted in 2025, was the easier lift: narrower subject, clearer analogies to existing payments regulation.
segments.tr: पहला हिस्सा, 2025 में लागू स्थिरकॉइन (stablecoin) कानून था, जो आसान था: संकीर्ण विषय, मौजूदा भुगतान नियमों के स्पष्ट सादृश्य।

segments.src: Market structure is where the genuinely hard trade-offs live.
segments.tr: मार्केट स्ट्रक्चर वह जगह है जहाँ वास्तव में कठिन समझौते होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the recess date matters more than it looks
segments.tr: ## अवकाश की तारीख दिखने से ज्यादा क्यों मायने रखती है

segments.src: Floor time in the Senate is the scarcest resource in American government, and a bill like this consumes a lot of it.
segments.tr: सीनेट में फ्लोर टाइम अमेरिकी सरकार में सबसे दुर्लभ संसाधन है, और इस तरह का विधेयक इसका बहुत अधिक उपभोग करता है।

segments.src: Under normal order, market-structure legislation needs to clear **two committees** — Banking (for the securities side) and Agriculture (which oversees the CFTC) — before it gets a floor slot.
segments.tr: सामान्य आदेश के तहत, मार्केट-स्ट्रक्चर कानून को फ्लोर स्लॉट मिलने से पहले **दो समितियों** — बैंकिंग (सिक्योरिटीज पक्ष के लिए) और कृषि (जो CFTC की देखरेख करती है) — से गुजरना पड़ता है।

segments.src: It then needs 60 votes to break a filibuster, which means a meaningful bloc of Democratic support, not just party-line agreement.
segments.tr: फिर इसे फिलिबस्टर को तोड़ने के लिए 60 वोटों की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसका अर्थ है लोकतांत्रिक समर्थन का एक सार्थक ब्लॉक, न कि केवल पार्टी-लाइन सहमति।

segments.src: Each of those steps takes days the Senate does not have many of.
segments.tr: इनमें से प्रत्येक कदम उन दिनों को लेता है जो सीनेट के पास बहुत कम हैं।

segments.src: The competing demands are familiar.
segments.tr: प्रतिस्पर्धी मांगें परिचित हैं।

segments.src: Appropriations deadlines arrive in the fall with a hard edge that crypto policy does not have.
segments.tr: विनियोजन (Appropriations) की समय-सीमा पतझड़ में एक कठोरता के साथ आती है जो क्रिप्टो नीति में नहीं है।

segments.src: Nominations consume floor time continuously.
segments.tr: नामांकन लगातार फ्लोर टाइम का उपभोग करते हैं।

segments.src: And in an election year, the window for anything requiring sustained cross-party negotiation narrows sharply after Labor Day, as members redirect attention toward campaigns and toward votes that are easier to explain at home.
segments.tr: और एक चुनाव वर्ष में, निरंतर क्रॉस-पार्टी बातचीत की आवश्यकता वाली किसी भी चीज़ के लिए खिड़की लेबर डे के बाद तेजी से संकरी हो जाती है, क्योंकि सदस्य अपना ध्यान अभियानों और उन वोटों की ओर मोड़ते हैं जिन्हें घर पर समझाना आसान होता है।

segments.src: That's the real mechanism behind the "past 2026" warning.
segments.tr: यही "2026 के बाद" की चेतावनी के पीछे का वास्तविक तंत्र है।

segments.src: If the bill doesn't have a negotiated text before recess, it returns in September into a shorter, more crowded calendar with less appetite for compromise.
segments.tr: यदि अवकाश से पहले विधेयक का कोई बातचीत किया गया पाठ नहीं है, तो यह सितंबर में एक छोटे, अधिक भीड़भाड़ वाले कैलेंडर में लौटता है जिसमें समझौते की भूख कम होती है।

segments.src: And bills that don't pass in a Congress don't carry over — they start again from introduction in the next one, with a possibly different committee balance and a re-litigated text.
segments.tr: और जो विधेयक एक कांग्रेस में पारित नहीं होते वे आगे नहीं बढ़ते — वे अगली कांग्रेस में परिचय से फिर से शुरू होते हैं, जिसमें संभवतः एक अलग समिति संतुलन और एक पुन: मुकदमेबाजी वाला पाठ होता है।

segments.src: ## Fight one: ethics rules for officeholders who hold tokens
segments.tr: ## लड़ाई एक: टोकन रखने वाले पदाधिकारियों के लिए नैतिकता नियम

segments.src: The first unresolved issue is not about market plumbing at all.
segments.tr: पहला अनसुलझा मुद्दा मार्केट प्लंबिंग के बारे में बिल्कुल नहीं है।

segments.src: It's about who in government may own, issue, or promote digital assets.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में है कि सरकार में कौन डिजिटल संपत्तियों का स्वामित्व रख सकता है, उन्हें जारी कर सकता है या उनका प्रचार कर सकता है।

segments.src: Several Democratic negotiators have pressed for conflict-of-interest provisions — variously drafted to cover the President, Vice President, members of Congress, senior executive branch officials, and in some versions their immediate families — restricting the issuance or sponsorship of digital assets while in office.
segments.tr: कई लोकतांत्रिक वार्ताकारों ने हितों के टकराव के प्रावधानों के लिए दबाव डाला है — जिन्हें राष्ट्रपति, उपराष्ट्रपति, कांग्रेस के सदस्यों, वरिष्ठ कार्यकारी शाखा के अधिकारियों और कुछ संस्करणों में उनके तत्काल परिवारों को कवर करने के लिए अलग-अलग तैयार किया गया है — जो पद पर रहते हुए डिजिटल संपत्तियों के जारी करने या प्रायोजन को प्रतिबंधित करते हैं।

segments.src: Public reporting through 2025 and 2026 has tied the intensity of this demand to the crypto ventures associated with the President's family, and supporters describe it as a straightforward extension of existing financial conflict rules to a new asset class.
segments.tr: 2025 और 2026 तक की सार्वजनिक रिपोर्टिंग ने इस मांग की तीव्रता को राष्ट्रपति के परिवार से जुड़े क्रिप्टो उद्यमों से जोड़ा है, और समर्थक इसे एक नई संपत्ति श्रेणी के लिए मौजूदा वित्तीय संघर्ष नियमों के एक सीधे विस्तार के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: Republican negotiators have generally argued the opposite: that ethics rules are a separate subject from market structure, that folding them in converts a technical bill into a political one, and that any such provisions belong in standalone legislation.
segments.tr: रिपब्लिकन वार्ताकारों ने आम तौर पर इसके विपरीत तर्क दिया है: कि नैतिकता नियम मार्केट स्ट्रक्चर से एक अलग विषय हैं, कि उन्हें इसमें शामिल करने से एक तकनीकी विधेयक एक राजनीतिक विधेयक में बदल जाता है, और कि ऐसे कोई भी प्रावधान स्टैंडअलोन कानून में होने चाहिए।

segments.src: Both positions are internally coherent, which is exactly why the fight is hard.
segments.tr: दोनों स्थितियाँ आंतरिक रूप से सुसंगत हैं, यही कारण है कि यह लड़ाई कठिन है।

segments.src: It isn't a drafting disagreement that a good staff lawyer can resolve overnight.
segments.tr: यह कोई ड्राफ्टिंग असहमति नहीं है जिसे एक अच्छा स्टाफ वकील रातों-रात हल कर सके।

segments.src: It's a disagreement about what the bill is for — and for some Democrats, the ethics language has become the price of the votes needed to reach 60.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में असहमति है कि विधेयक किस लिए है — और कुछ डेमोक्रेट्स के लिए, नैतिकता की भाषा 60 तक पहुँचने के लिए आवश्यक वोटों की कीमत बन गई है।

segments.src: ## Fight two: illicit finance
segments.tr: ## लड़ाई दो: अवैध वित्त

segments.src: The second issue is more technical and, in some ways, harder.
segments.tr: दूसरा मुद्दा अधिक तकनीकी है और कुछ मायनों में अधिक कठिन है।

segments.src: Everyone in the debate agrees that sanctions evasion, ransomware payments, and laundering through digital assets are real problems.
segments.tr: बहस में हर कोई सहमत है कि प्रतिबंधों से बचना, रैनसमवेयर भुगतान और डिजिटल संपत्तियों के माध्यम से लॉन्ड्रिंग वास्तविक समस्याएं हैं।

segments.src: The disagreement is about where obligations should attach.
segments.tr: असहमति इस बारे में है कि दायित्व कहाँ जुड़ने चाहिए।

segments.src: Traditional anti-money-laundering law is built around **intermediaries**: a bank, a broker, an exchange — an entity that knows its customers and can file reports.
segments.tr: पारंपरिक एंटी-मनी-लॉन्ड्रिंग कानून **मध्यस्थों** के इर्द-गिर्द बनाया गया है: एक बैंक, एक ब्रोकर, एक एक्सचेंज — एक इकाई जो अपने ग्राहकों को जानती है और रिपोर्ट दाखिल कर सकती है।

segments.src: Decentralized finance complicates that model.
segments.tr: विकेंद्रीकृत वित्त (Decentralized finance) उस मॉडल को जटिल बनाता है।

segments.src: When software runs autonomously and no one holds customer funds, it is genuinely unclear who the regulated party is supposed to be.
segments.tr: जब सॉफ़्टवेयर स्वायत्त रूप से चलता है और कोई भी ग्राहक फंड नहीं रखता है, तो यह वास्तव में अस्पष्ट होता है कि विनियमित पार्टी कौन होनी चाहिए।

segments.src: Two camps have formed.
segments.tr: दो शिविर बन गए हैं।

segments.src: One wants to extend Bank Secrecy Act–style obligations further into the digital asset stack, arguing that a regime with structural gaps invites use of those gaps.
segments.tr: एक चाहता है कि बैंक सीक्रेसी एक्ट-शैली के दायित्वों को डिजिटल संपत्ति स्टैक में और आगे बढ़ाया जाए, यह तर्क देते हुए कि संरचनात्मक अंतराल वाला शासन उन अंतरालों के उपयोग को आमंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: The other wants explicit protection for developers of non-custodial software — the position that publishing code isn't operating a money transmitting business — warning that broad liability would push development offshore without meaningfully deterring sophisticated bad actors.
segments.tr: दूसरा गैर-कस्टोडियल सॉफ़्टवेयर के डेवलपर्स के लिए स्पष्ट सुरक्षा चाहता है — यह स्थिति कि कोड प्रकाशित करना धन प्रेषण व्यवसाय संचालित करना नहीं है — चेतावनी देते हुए कि व्यापक दायित्व परिष्कृत बुरे अभिनेताओं को सार्थक रूप से रोके बिना विकास को ऑफशोर धकेल देगा।

segments.src: Related questions ride along: how to treat mixing services, what to do about privacy-preserving technologies with both legitimate and illegitimate uses, and how much new authority Treasury should receive.
segments.tr: संबंधित प्रश्न साथ चलते हैं: मिक्सिंग सेवाओं के साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया जाए, वैध और अवैध दोनों उपयोगों वाली गोपनीयता-संरक्षण प्रौद्योगिकियों के बारे में क्या किया जाए, और ट्रेजरी को कितनी नई शक्ति मिलनी चाहिए।

segments.src: None of these have obvious compromise landing zones, and unlike the ethics fight, they can't be resolved by simply deciding whether a section stays in or comes out.
segments.tr: इनमें से किसी का भी स्पष्ट समझौता लैंडिंग ज़ोन नहीं है, और नैतिकता की लड़ाई के विपरीत, उन्हें केवल यह तय करके हल नहीं किया जा सकता कि कोई अनुभाग रहता है या बाहर आता है।

segments.src: ## What passing — or not — would actually change
segments.tr: ## पारित होने — या न होने — से वास्तव में क्या बदलेगा

segments.src: It's worth being precise about the stakes, because both sides of the debate have incentives to overstate them.
segments.tr: दांव के बारे में सटीक होना सार्थक है, क्योंकि बहस के दोनों पक्षों के पास उन्हें बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताने के प्रोत्साहन हैं।

segments.src: **If it passes:** firms gain a registration path and a defined regulator, which mainly affects institutional participants deciding how much compliance risk a U.S.
segments.tr: **यदि यह पारित होता है:** फर्मों को एक पंजीकरण पथ और एक परिभाषित नियामक मिलता है, जो मुख्य रूप से उन संस्थागत प्रतिभागियों को प्रभावित करता है जो यह तय कर रहे हैं कि एक अमेरिकी

segments.src: business carries.
segments.tr: व्यवसाय कितना अनुपालन जोखिम वहन करता है।

segments.src: It would not eliminate volatility, fraud, or loss.
segments.tr: यह अस्थिरता, धोखाधड़ी या हानि को समाप्त नहीं करेगा।

segments.src: Implementation would still take years of agency rulemaking after enactment.
segments.tr: लागू करने में अभी भी अधिनियमन के बाद एजेंसी नियम बनाने में वर्षों लगेंगे।

segments.src: **If it stalls:** the current regime continues — meaning agency policy, enforcement discretion, and litigation outcomes remain the operative rulebook, and can shift with each administration.
segments.tr: **यदि यह रुक जाता है:** वर्तमान शासन जारी रहता है — जिसका अर्थ है कि एजेंसी नीति, प्रवर्तन विवेक और मुकदमेबाजी के परिणाम प्रभावी रूलबुक बने रहते हैं, और प्रत्येक प्रशासन के साथ बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: That instability is the specific thing the industry says it wants fixed, and the specific thing skeptics say is preferable to a framework they consider too permissive.
segments.tr: यही वह अस्थिरता है जिसे उद्योग ठीक करना चाहता है, और वही वह चीज़ है जिसे संशयवादी उस ढांचे से बेहतर बताते हैं जिसे वे बहुत अधिक उदार मानते हैं।

segments.src: Neither outcome is a verdict on any particular asset's value.
segments.tr: कोई भी परिणाम किसी विशेष संपत्ति के मूल्य पर फैसला नहीं है।

segments.src: Legislation shapes who supervises a market; it does not underwrite it.
segments.tr: कानून यह आकार देता है कि बाजार की निगरानी कौन करता है; यह इसकी गारंटी नहीं देता।

segments.src: ## What to watch in the next few days
segments.tr: ## अगले कुछ दिनों में क्या देखना है

segments.src: A handful of concrete signals will tell you more than any headline:
segments.tr: कुछ ठोस संकेत आपको किसी भी हेडलाइन से अधिक बताएंगे:

segments.src: 1. **Does a joint Banking–Agriculture text appear?** A single released draft with both committees' names on it is the clearest evidence real negotiation succeeded.
segments.tr: 1. **क्या एक संयुक्त बैंकिंग-कृषि पाठ दिखाई देता है?** दोनों समितियों के नाम वाला एक एकल जारी ड्राफ्ट इस बात का सबसे स्पष्ट प्रमाण है कि वास्तविक बातचीत सफल रही।

segments.src: 2. **Is a markup noticed?** Committees post hearing and markup notices in advance. No notice before recess means no committee action before September.
segments.tr: 2. **क्या मार्कअप नोटिस दिया गया है?** समितियाँ सुनवाई और मार्कअप नोटिस पहले से पोस्ट करती हैं। अवकाश से पहले कोई नोटिस नहीं होने का मतलब है सितंबर से पहले कोई समिति कार्रवाई नहीं।

segments.src: 3. **Do the Democratic negotiators issue a statement?** Whether the group that has been negotiating describes talks as ongoing or stalled is the most direct read on whether 60 votes are reachable.
segments.tr: 3. **क्या लोकतांत्रिक वार्ताकार बयान जारी करते हैं?** क्या बातचीत करने वाला समूह चर्चाओं को जारी या ठप बताता है, यह इस बात का सबसे सीधा संकेत है कि क्या 60 वोट प्राप्त किए जा सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Is the ethics language in a separate vehicle?** If conflict-of-interest provisions get spun into a standalone bill, that's the shape a compromise would most likely take.
segments.tr: 4. **क्या नैतिकता की भाषा एक अलग वाहन में है?** यदि हितों के टकराव के प्रावधानों को एक स्टैंडअलोन विधेयक में बदल दिया जाता है, तो यही वह रूप है जो एक समझौता सबसे अधिक संभावना के साथ लेगा।

segments.src: 5. **Does leadership commit floor time for the fall?** A scheduling commitment survives recess; a general expression of support usually doesn't.
segments.tr: 5. **क्या नेतृत्व पतझड़ के लिए फ्लोर टाइम प्रतिबद्ध करता है?** एक शेड्यूलिंग प्रतिबद्धता अवकाश के बाद भी जीवित रहती है; समर्थन की एक सामान्य अभिव्यक्ति आमतौर पर नहीं रहती।

segments.src: ## The unglamorous conclusion
segments.tr: ## ग्लैमर रहित निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Big legislation rarely fails because someone loses an argument.
segments.tr: बड़ा कानून शायद ही कभी इसलिए विफल होता है क्योंकि कोई तर्क हार जाता है।

segments.src: It fails because the calendar closes while the argument is still running.
segments.tr: यह इसलिए विफल होता है क्योंकि तर्क चलते रहने के दौरान कैलेंडर बंद हो जाता है।

segments.src: The CLARITY Act cleared the harder-looking chamber more than a year ago with bipartisan support.
segments.tr: CLARITY एक्ट एक साल से अधिक समय पहले द्विदलीय समर्थन के साथ अधिक कठिन दिखने वाले सदन से पारित हो गया था।

segments.src: What it faces now isn't ideological opposition so much as arithmetic: two genuinely unresolved policy fights, two committees of jurisdiction, a 60-vote threshold, and a shrinking number of legislative days before an election year absorbs whatever is left.
segments.tr: अब इसका सामना वैचारिक विरोध से उतना नहीं है जितना कि गणित से: दो वास्तव में अनसुलझी नीति लड़ाई, अधिकार क्षेत्र की दो समितियाँ, 60-वोट की सीमा, और विधायी दिनों की घटती संख्या इससे पहले कि एक चुनाव वर्ष जो कुछ भी बचा है उसे सोख ले।

segments.src: That may still be enough.
segments.tr: यह अभी भी पर्याप्त हो सकता है।

segments.src: Congress has done more in less time when leadership decided a bill would move.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस ने कम समय में अधिक काम किया है जब नेतृत्व ने तय किया कि एक विधेयक आगे बढ़ेगा।

segments.src: But the honest read, as the Senate approaches its August departure, is that the outcome depends less on the merits of the framework than on whether two negotiating teams can close two hard gaps in a very small number of working days — and, failing that, whether anyone still has the appetite to pick it up again in September.
segments.tr: लेकिन ईमानदार विश्लेषण, जैसे-जैसे सीनेट अपने अगस्त प्रस्थान के करीब पहुँचती है, यह है कि परिणाम ढांचे के गुणों की तुलना में इस बात पर कम निर्भर करता है कि क्या दो बातचीत करने वाली टीमें बहुत कम कार्य दिवसों में दो कठिन अंतरालों को भर सकती हैं — और, यदि ऐसा नहीं होता है, तो क्या किसी में सितंबर में इसे फिर से उठाने की भूख है।

segments.src: ## What the CLARITY Act is actually trying to do

segments.src: - **Define a transition test** — often discussed as whether a blockchain has become sufficiently decentralized — that lets an asset move from the securities regime into the commodities regime as its underlying network matures.

segments.src: The first unresolved issue is not about market plumbing at all.
segments.tr: Se trata de quién en el gobierno puede poseer, emitir o promover activos digitales.\n

segments.tr: Varios negociadores demócratas han presionado por disposiciones sobre conflictos de interés — redactadas de diversas maneras para cubrir al Presidente, Vicepresidente, miembros del Congreso, altos funcionarios del poder ejecutivo y, en algunas versiones, a sus familias inmediatas — restringiendo la emisión o el patrocinio de activos digitales mientras estén en el cargo.

segments.src: Several Democratic negotiators have pressed for conflict-of-interest provisions — variously drafted to cover the President, Vice President, members of Congress, senior executive branch officials, and in some versions their immediate families — restricting the issuance or sponsorship of digital assets while in office.
segments.tr: Los reportes públicos hasta 2025 y 2026 han vinculado la intensidad de esta demanda con los emprendimientos cripto asociados con la familia del Presidente, y los defensores lo describen como una extensión directa de las reglas de conflicto financiero existentes a una nueva clase de activos.\n

segments.src: Public reporting through 2025 and 2026 has tied the intensity of this demand to the crypto ventures associated with the President's family, and supporters describe it as a straightforward extension of existing financial conflict rules to a new asset class.
segments.tr: Los negociadores republicanos generalmente han argumentado lo contrario: que las reglas éticas son un tema separado de la estructura del mercado, que incluirlas convierte un proyecto de ley técnico en uno político, y que cualquier disposición de este tipo pertenece en una legislación independiente.\n

segments.src: Republican negotiators have generally argued the opposite: that ethics rules are a separate subject from market structure, that folding them in converts a technical bill into a political one, and that any such provisions belong in standalone legislation.

segments.src: It's a disagreement about what the bill is for — and for some Democrats, the ethics language has become the price of the votes needed to reach 60.

segments.src: ## Fight two: illicit finance
segments.tr: El segundo problema es más técnico y, en algunos sentidos, más difícil.\n

segments.src: The second issue is more technical and, in some ways, harder.

segments.src: Everyone in the debate agrees that sanctions evasion, ransomware payments, and laundering through digital assets are real problems.

segments.tr: La ley tradicional contra el lavado de dinero se basa en **intermediarios**: un banco, un broker, un exchange — una entidad que conoce a sus clientes y puede presentar informes.

segments.src: When software runs autonomously and no one holds customer funds, it is genuinely unclear who the regulated party is supposed to be.
segments.tr: Se han formado dos bandos.

segments.src: Two camps have formed.
segments.tr: Uno quiere extender las obligaciones al estilo de la Bank Secrecy Act más profundamente en la pila de activos digitales, argumentando que un régimen con brechas estructurales invita al uso de esas brechas.

segments.src: One wants to extend Bank Secrecy Act–style obligations further into the digital asset stack, arguing that a regime with structural gaps invites use of those gaps.
segments.tr: El otro quiere protección explícita para los desarrolladores de software no custodio — la posición de que publicar código no es operar un negocio de transmisión de dinero — advirtiendo que una responsabilidad amplia empujaría el desarrollo al extranjero sin disuadir significativamente a los actores maliciosos sofisticados.\n

segments.src: The other wants explicit protection for developers of non-custodial software — the position that publishing code isn't operating a money transmitting business — warning that broad liability would push development offshore without meaningfully deterring sophisticated bad actors.
segments.tr: Preguntas relacionadas surgen: cómo tratar los servicios de mezcla (mixing), qué hacer con las tecnologías de preservación de la privacidad que tienen usos tanto legítimos como ilegítimos, y cuánta autoridad nueva debería recibir el Tesoro.\n

segments.src: Related questions ride along: how to treat mixing services, what to do about privacy-preserving technologies with both legitimate and illegitimate uses, and how much new authority Treasury should receive.
segments.tr: Ninguna de estas tiene zonas de compromiso obvias, y a diferencia de la pelea ética, no pueden resolverse simplemente decidiendo si una sección permanece o se elimina.\n

segments.src: ## What to watch in the next few days
segments.tr: 1. **¿Aparece un texto conjunto de Banca y Agricultura?** Un único borrador publicado con los nombres de ambos comités es la evidencia más clara de que la negociación real tuvo éxito.\n

segments.src: A handful of concrete signals will tell you more than any headline:
segments.tr: 2. **¿Se notifica una sesión de enmiendas (markup)?** Los comités publican avisos de audiencias y markups con antelación. Ningún aviso antes del receso significa que no habrá acción del comité antes de septiembre.\n

segments.src: 1. **Does a joint Banking–Agriculture text appear?** A single released draft with both committees' names on it is the clearest evidence real negotiation succeeded.
segments.tr: 3. **¿Emiten una declaración los negociadores demócratas?** El hecho de que el grupo que ha estado negociando describa las conversaciones como continuas o estancadas es la lectura más directa sobre si los 60 votos son alcanzables.\n

segments.src: 2. **Is a markup noticed?** Committees post hearing and markup notices in advance. No notice before recess means no committee action before September.
segments.tr: 4. **¿Está el lenguaje ético en un vehículo separado?** Si las disposiciones sobre conflictos de interés se convierten en un proyecto de ley independiente, esa es la forma que probablemente tomaría un compromiso.\n

segments.src: 3. **Do the Democratic negotiators issue a statement?** Whether the group that has been negotiating describes talks as ongoing or stalled is the most direct read on whether 60 votes are reachable.
segments.tr: 5. **¿Se compromete el liderazgo tiempo de pleno para el otoño?** Un compromiso de programación sobrevive al receso; una expresión general de apoyo usualmente no.\n

segments.src: 4. **Is the ethics language in a separate vehicle?** If conflict-of-interest provisions get spun into a standalone bill, that's the shape a compromise would most likely take.

segments.src: 5. **Does leadership commit floor time for the fall?** A scheduling commitment survives recess; a general expression of support usually doesn't.

segments.tr: Falla porque el calendario se cierra mientras el argumento sigue en curso.\n

segments.tr: La Ley CLARITY superó la cámara que parecía más difícil hace más de un año con apoyo bipartidista.

segments.tr: A lo que se enfrenta ahora no es tanto una oposición ideológica como una aritmética: dos peleas políticas genuinamente no resueltas, dos comités de jurisdicción, un umbral de 60 votos y un número decreciente de días legislativos antes de que un año electoral absorba lo que quede.\n

segments.src: The CLARITY Act cleared the harder-looking chamber more than a year ago with bipartisan support.
segments.tr: Eso puede ser suficiente.

segments.src: What it faces now isn't ideological opposition so much as arithmetic: two genuinely unresolved policy fights, two committees of jurisdiction, a 60-vote threshold, and a shrinking number of legislative days before an election year absorbs whatever is left.
segments.tr: El Congreso ha hecho más en menos tiempo cuando el liderazgo decidió que un proyecto de ley avanzaría.

segments.src: That may still be enough.
segments.tr: Pero la lectura honesta, a medida que el Senado se acerca a su partida de agosto, es que el resultado depende menos de los méritos del marco que de si dos equipos de negociación pueden cerrar dos brechas difíciles en un número muy pequeño de días laborables — y, si no lo logran, de si alguien todavía tiene el apetito para retomarlo en septiembre.\n

segments.tr: Setiap langkah tersebut memakan waktu berhari-hari yang tidak dimiliki Senat dalam jumlah banyak.

segments.src: Each of those steps takes days the Senate does not have many of.
segments.tr: Tuntutan yang bersaing sudah tidak asing lagi.

segments.src: The competing demands are familiar.
segments.tr: Tenggat waktu alokasi anggaran tiba di musim gugur dengan ketegasan yang tidak dimiliki oleh kebijakan kripto.

segments.src: Appropriations deadlines arrive in the fall with a hard edge that crypto policy does not have.
segments.tr: Nominasi menghabiskan waktu sidang secara terus-menerus.

segments.src: Nominations consume floor time continuously.
segments.tr: Dan dalam tahun pemilihan, jendela untuk apa pun yang memerlukan negosiasi lintas partai yang berkelanjutan menyempit tajam setelah Hari Buruh, karena anggota mengalihkan perhatian mereka ke kampanye dan ke suara yang lebih mudah dijelaskan di rumah.

segments.src: And in an election year, the window for anything requiring sustained cross-party negotiation narrows sharply after Labor Day, as members redirect attention toward campaigns and toward votes that are easier to explain at home.
segments.tr: Itulah mekanisme nyata di balik peringatan "melewati 2026".

segments.src: That's the real mechanism behind the "past 2026" warning.
segments.tr: Jika rancangan undang-undang tersebut tidak memiliki teks yang dinegosiasikan sebelum reses, ia akan kembali pada bulan September ke dalam kalender yang lebih pendek dan lebih padat dengan keinginan kompromi yang lebih sedikit.

segments.src: If the bill doesn't have a negotiated text before recess, it returns in September into a shorter, more crowded calendar with less appetite for compromise.
segments.tr: Dan rancangan undang-undang yang tidak lolos dalam satu periode Kongres tidak terbawa — mereka mulai lagi dari pengenalan di periode berikutnya, dengan keseimbangan komite yang mungkin berbeda dan teks yang diperdebatkan kembali.

segments.src: And bills that don't pass in a Congress don't carry over — they start again from introduction in the next one, with a possibly different committee balance and a re-litigated text.
segments.tr: ## Pertarungan satu: aturan etika untuk pemegang jabatan yang memiliki token

segments.src: ## Fight one: ethics rules for officeholders who hold tokens
segments.tr: Masalah pertama yang belum terselesaikan bukan tentang infrastruktur pasar sama sekali.

segments.src: The first unresolved issue is not about market plumbing at all.
segments.tr: Ini tentang siapa di pemerintahan yang boleh memiliki, menerbitkan, atau mempromosikan aset digital.

segments.src: It's about who in government may own, issue, or promote digital assets.
segments.tr: Beberapa negosiator Demokrat telah mendesak ketentuan konflik kepentingan — yang dirancang secara bervariasi untuk mencakup Presiden, Wakil Presiden, anggota Kongres, pejabat eksekutif senior, dan dalam beberapa versi keluarga inti mereka — yang membatasi penerbitan atau sponsor aset digital selama menjabat.

segments.src: Several Democratic negotiators have pressed for conflict-of-interest provisions — variously drafted to cover the President, Vice President, members of Congress, senior executive branch officials, and in some versions their immediate families — restricting the issuance or sponsorship of digital assets while in office.
segments.tr: Laporan publik sepanjang 2025 dan 2026 telah mengaitkan intensitas tuntutan ini dengan ventura kripto yang terkait dengan keluarga Presiden, dan pendukungnya menggambarkannya sebagai perluasan langsung dari aturan konflik keuangan yang ada ke kelas aset baru.

segments.src: Public reporting through 2025 and 2026 has tied the intensity of this demand to the crypto ventures associated with the President's family, and supporters describe it as a straightforward extension of existing financial conflict rules to a new asset class.
segments.tr: Negosiator Republikan umumnya berpendapat sebaliknya: bahwa aturan etika adalah subjek terpisah dari struktur pasar, bahwa memasukkannya mengubah rancangan undang-undang teknis menjadi politik, dan bahwa ketentuan semacam itu seharusnya berada dalam legislasi yang berdiri sendiri.

segments.src: Republican negotiators have generally argued the opposite: that ethics rules are a separate subject from market structure, that folding them in converts a technical bill into a political one, and that any such provisions belong in standalone legislation.
segments.tr: Kedua posisi tersebut konsisten secara internal, yang justru membuat pertarungan ini sulit.

segments.src: Both positions are internally coherent, which is exactly why the fight is hard.
segments.tr: Ini bukan ketidaksepakatan penyusunan yang dapat diselesaikan oleh pengacara staf yang baik dalam semalam.

segments.src: It isn't a drafting disagreement that a good staff lawyer can resolve overnight.
segments.tr: Ini adalah ketidaksepakatan tentang untuk apa rancangan undang-undang tersebut — dan bagi beberapa Demokrat, bahasa etika telah menjadi harga dari suara yang dibutuhkan untuk mencapai 60.

segments.src: It's a disagreement about what the bill is for — and for some Democrats, the ethics language has become the price of the votes needed to reach 60.
segments.tr: ## Pertarungan dua: keuangan ilegal

segments.src: ## Fight two: illicit finance
segments.tr: Masalah kedua lebih teknis dan, dalam beberapa hal, lebih sulit.

segments.src: The second issue is more technical and, in some ways, harder.
segments.tr: Semua orang dalam debat setuju bahwa penghindaran sanksi, pembayaran ransomware, dan pencucian uang melalui aset digital adalah masalah nyata.

segments.src: Everyone in the debate agrees that sanctions evasion, ransomware payments, and laundering through digital assets are real problems.
segments.tr: Ketidaksepakatan adalah tentang di mana kewajiban harus melekat.

segments.src: The disagreement is about where obligations should attach.
segments.tr: Hukum anti-pencucian uang tradisional dibangun di sekitar **perantara**: bank, broker, bursa — entitas yang mengenal pelanggannya dan dapat mengajukan laporan.

segments.src: Traditional anti-money-laundering law is built around **intermediaries**: a bank, a broker, an exchange — an entity that knows its customers and can file reports.
segments.tr: Keuangan terdesentralisasi (DeFi) memperumit model tersebut.

segments.src: Decentralized finance complicates that model.
segments.tr: Ketika perangkat lunak berjalan secara otonom dan tidak ada yang memegang dana pelanggan, benar-benar tidak jelas siapa pihak yang seharusnya diregulasi.

segments.src: When software runs autonomously and no one holds customer funds, it is genuinely unclear who the regulated party is supposed to be.
segments.tr: Dua kubu telah terbentuk.

segments.src: Two camps have formed.
segments.tr: Satu ingin memperluas kewajiban gaya Bank Secrecy Act lebih jauh ke dalam tumpukan aset digital, berpendapat bahwa rezim dengan celah struktural mengundang penggunaan celah tersebut.

segments.src: One wants to extend Bank Secrecy Act–style obligations further into the digital asset stack, arguing that a regime with structural gaps invites use of those gaps.
segments.tr: Kubu lain menginginkan perlindungan eksplisit bagi pengembang perangkat lunak non-kustodial — posisi bahwa menerbitkan kode bukan berarti mengoperasikan bisnis pengiriman uang — memperingatkan bahwa tanggung jawab luas akan mendorong pengembangan ke luar negeri tanpa secara berarti menghalangi pelaku jahat yang canggih.

segments.src: The other wants explicit protection for developers of non-custodial software — the position that publishing code isn't operating a money transmitting business — warning that broad liability would push development offshore without meaningfully deterring sophisticated bad actors.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan terkait ikut serta: bagaimana memperlakukan layanan pencampuran (mixing services), apa yang harus dilakukan dengan teknologi pelindung privasi dengan penggunaan sah dan tidak sah, dan seberapa banyak otoritas baru yang harus diterima Departemen Keuangan.

segments.src: Related questions ride along: how to treat mixing services, what to do about privacy-preserving technologies with both legitimate and illegitimate uses, and how much new authority Treasury should receive.
segments.tr: Tidak ada dari hal ini yang memiliki zona kompromi yang jelas, dan tidak seperti pertarungan etika, hal-hal ini tidak dapat diselesaikan hanya dengan memutuskan apakah suatu bagian tetap ada atau dihapus.

segments.src: None of these have obvious compromise landing zones, and unlike the ethics fight, they can't be resolved by simply deciding whether a section stays in or comes out.
segments.tr: ## Apa yang akan berubah jika disahkan — atau tidak

segments.src: ## What passing — or not — would actually change
segments.tr: Penting untuk bersikap tepat tentang risikonya, karena kedua belah pihak dalam debat memiliki insentif untuk melebih-lebihkannya.

segments.src: It's worth being precise about the stakes, because both sides of the debate have incentives to overstate them.
segments.tr: **Jika disahkan:** perusahaan mendapatkan jalur pendaftaran dan regulator yang ditentukan, yang terutama memengaruhi peserta institusional yang memutuskan seberapa besar risiko kepatuhan yang ditanggung oleh bisnis AS.

segments.src: **If it passes:** firms gain a registration path and a defined regulator, which mainly affects institutional participants deciding how much compliance risk a U.S.
segments.tr: Hal itu tidak akan menghilangkan volatilitas, penipuan, atau kerugian.

segments.src: business carries.
segments.tr: Implementasi masih akan memakan waktu bertahun-tahun pembuatan aturan lembaga setelah pengesahan.

segments.src: It would not eliminate volatility, fraud, or loss.
segments.tr: **Jika terhenti:** rezim saat ini berlanjut — artinya kebijakan lembaga, diskresi penegakan hukum, dan hasil litigasi tetap menjadi buku aturan yang berlaku, dan dapat bergeser dengan setiap pemerintahan.

segments.src: Implementation would still take years of agency rulemaking after enactment.
segments.tr: Ketidakstabilan itulah yang dikatakan industri ingin diperbaiki, dan hal spesifik yang dikatakan skeptis lebih baik daripada kerangka kerja yang mereka anggap terlalu permisif.

segments.src: **If it stalls:** the current regime continues — meaning agency policy, enforcement discretion, and litigation outcomes remain the operative rulebook, and can shift with each administration.
segments.tr: Tidak ada hasil yang merupakan vonis atas nilai aset tertentu.

segments.src: That instability is the specific thing the industry says it wants fixed, and the specific thing skeptics say is preferable to a framework they consider too permissive.
segments.tr: Legislasi membentuk siapa yang mengawasi pasar; ia tidak menjamin nilainya.

segments.src: Neither outcome is a verdict on any particular asset's value.
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan dalam beberapa hari ke depan

segments.src: Legislation shapes who supervises a market; it does not underwrite it.
segments.tr: Beberapa sinyal konkret akan memberi tahu Anda lebih banyak daripada tajuk utama mana pun:

segments.src: ## What to watch in the next few days
segments.tr: 1. **Apakah teks gabungan Perbankan–Pertanian muncul?** Draf tunggal yang dirilis dengan nama kedua komite di atasnya adalah bukti terjelas bahwa negosiasi nyata berhasil.

segments.src: A handful of concrete signals will tell you more than any headline:
segments.tr: 2. **Apakah markup diperhatikan?** Komite memposting pemberitahuan sidang dan markup sebelumnya. Tidak ada pemberitahuan sebelum reses berarti tidak ada tindakan komite sebelum September.

segments.src: 1. **Does a joint Banking–Agriculture text appear?** A single released draft with both committees' names on it is the clearest evidence real negotiation succeeded.
segments.tr: 3. **Apakah negosiator Demokrat mengeluarkan pernyataan?** Apakah kelompok yang telah bernegosiasi menggambarkan pembicaraan sebagai sedang berlangsung atau terhenti adalah bacaan paling langsung tentang apakah 60 suara dapat dicapai.

segments.src: 2. **Is a markup noticed?** Committees post hearing and markup notices in advance. No notice before recess means no committee action before September.
segments.tr: 4. **Apakah bahasa etika berada dalam kendaraan terpisah?** Jika ketentuan konflik kepentingan diputar menjadi rancangan undang-undang yang berdiri sendiri, itulah bentuk kompromi yang paling mungkin terjadi.

segments.src: 3. **Do the Democratic negotiators issue a statement?** Whether the group that has been negotiating describes talks as ongoing or stalled is the most direct read on whether 60 votes are reachable.
segments.tr: 5. **Apakah pimpinan berkomitmen memberikan waktu sidang untuk musim gugur?** Komitmen penjadwalan bertahan melewati reses; ekspresi dukungan umum biasanya tidak.

segments.src: 4. **Is the ethics language in a separate vehicle?** If conflict-of-interest provisions get spun into a standalone bill, that's the shape a compromise would most likely take.
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan yang tidak glamor

segments.src: 5. **Does leadership commit floor time for the fall?** A scheduling commitment survives recess; a general expression of support usually doesn't.
segments.tr: Legislasi besar jarang gagal karena seseorang kalah dalam argumen.

segments.src: ## The unglamorous conclusion
segments.tr: Ia gagal karena kalender tertutup sementara argumen masih berlangsung.

segments.src: Big legislation rarely fails because someone loses an argument.
segments.tr: CLARITY Act telah melewati kamar yang terlihat lebih sulit lebih dari setahun yang lalu dengan dukungan bipartisan.

segments.src: It fails because the calendar closes while the argument is still running.
segments.tr: Apa yang dihadapinya sekarang bukan oposisi ideologis melainkan aritmatika: dua pertarungan kebijakan yang benar-benar belum terselesaikan, dua komite yurisdiksi, ambang batas 60 suara, dan jumlah hari legislatif yang menyusut sebelum tahun pemilihan menyerap apa pun yang tersisa.

segments.src: The CLARITY Act cleared the harder-looking chamber more than a year ago with bipartisan support.
segments.tr: Itu mungkin masih cukup.

segments.src: What it faces now isn't ideological opposition so much as arithmetic: two genuinely unresolved policy fights, two committees of jurisdiction, a 60-vote threshold, and a shrinking number of legislative days before an election year absorbs whatever is left.
segments.tr: Kongres telah melakukan lebih banyak dalam waktu yang lebih singkat ketika pimpinan memutuskan bahwa sebuah rancangan undang-undang akan maju.

segments.src: That may still be enough.
segments.tr: Namun, bacaan jujur, saat Senat mendekati keberangkatan Agustusnya, adalah bahwa hasilnya kurang bergantung pada manfaat kerangka kerja tersebut daripada pada apakah dua tim negosiasi dapat menutup dua celah sulit dalam jumlah hari kerja yang sangat sedikit — dan, jika gagal, apakah ada yang masih memiliki keinginan untuk mengangkatnya kembali pada bulan September.

segments.src: Congress has done more in less time when leadership decided a bill would move.

But the honest read, as the Senate approaches its August departure, is that the outcome depends less on the merits of the framework than on whether two negotiating teams can close two hard gaps in a very small number of working days — and, failing that, whether anyone still has the appetite to pick it up again in September.
